notesForTheArchitect: Fast-follow, unchanged across three rounds and still not fixed here: folding rememberWait's positional arm bool into its own errors.As test, and renaming readyChecks, which reads no check. Both are on the pull request body's Fast-follow line.

For retro, the one technique this issue produced that outlives it: an outbox built with its pool pointed at a port nothing listens on makes rememberWait self-reporting - it returns nil when the gate refused to spend the notice, because it stops before the database, and an error naming the row when it set out to write. The general form is that a function returning early when it has nothing to persist can be tested for 'did it decide to write' with no database at all, as long as the early return is the only path that avoids one. That is what made the warn gate, the payload clock and the pre-release fallback drivable in a pod the architect's A2 had settled for CI alone on.
